assumptions.statement: Overall and key-area geometries are provisional rough repository substitutes, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, clipping, plans and figures must be regenerated after official geometry is obtained.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, height, FAR, density, setbacks, parking and municipal engineering conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The package makes no statutory intensity or engineering claim.

assumptions.statement: No cleared existing-building, ownership, occupancy, structure, fire or heritage survey is available.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are conceptual capacity envelopes; retain-renovate-demolish decisions remain gated.

assumptions.statement: Local late-night demand, station interfaces, routes, service intervals, fares and operating authority are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Shuttles and transfer halls are concepts requiring transport and operator validation.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, soil, geotechnical, power and fire-water data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green and infrastructure systems require specialist surveys before design development.

assumptions.statement: Staffing, minimum service directory, Last Service Week and joint governance are proposals, not commitments.
assumptions.impact: Pilot scope, accountable operators, budgets, thresholds and exit dates require agreement.

assumptions.statement: No individual night-travel data is needed for this concept; future pilots should use minimum, aggregated and purpose-limited data.
assumptions.impact: Any higher-risk processing requires separate legal, security, accessibility and public review.

assumptions.statement: Repository issue #1029 questions the provisional third key area's relationship to Dazhongsi.
assumptions.impact: Do not infer a precise station-area design from the provisional polygon; recompute the whole package after clarification.
